inferred_north_star.definition: Percentage of trial users who convert to a monthly plan and complete at least one exercise within the month.
inferred_north_star.justification: This metric captures the effectiveness of our onboarding process and user engagement strategy, which are critical for driving long-term retention and revenue growth.

supporting_metrics.name: W1 Retention
supporting_metrics.definition: Percentage of monthly plan converters who complete an exercise in Week 1 post-conversion.
supporting_metrics.why_it_matters: This metric provides insight into the effectiveness of our habit formation strategy and user engagement tactics.

lifecycle_stages.primary_goal: Get user to complete at least 1 exercise, feel the product value, and convert to a paid monthly plan.
Drive habit formation — at least 4 sessions/week.
Reframe setbacks as opportunities and celebrate small wins.
